# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolboy  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has a dark, sullen little face with black eyes.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)_

## Personality

He is an independent, mischievous little boy who makes up his own mind about things. Initially, he holds female teachers in contempt and believes girl teachers are no good. Despite his scornful demeanor, he is a reasonable child who can respect authority when shown strength.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c7 P11](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0011), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_

## Traits

- independent  <sub>[v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007)</sub>
- mischievous  <sub>[v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)</sub>
- sullen  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>
- contemptuous towards female teachers  <sub>[v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007)</sub>

## History

Anthony Pye attends Avonlea School and sits at a corner desk. When Anne Shirley begins her term as teacher, Anthony stares at her with a dark, sullen, and hostile expression, firmly believing that girl teachers are no good. He consistently treats her with a scornful air of toleration and refuses to respect her, causing Anne much worry as she tries to win his affection. Eventually, after Anne gives him a whipping, Anthony shifts his attitude and admits that her whipping was as good as a man's, finally earning his respect.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_

## Background by volume

- attended school under male teachers before Anne Shirley became his teacher  <sub>[v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007)</sub>
